def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for i in range(3 * h):
        tile_r, r = divmod(i, h)
        sr = h - 1 - r if tile_r != 1 else r
        row = []
        for j in range(3 * w):
            tile_c, c = divmod(j, w)
            sc = w - 1 - c if tile_c != 1 else c
            row.append(grid[sr][sc])
        out.append(row)
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':

    test = [[8,8,6],[6,3,6],[6,8,8]]
    print(transform(demo))
    print(transform(test))
PY
